screened_out.reason: Korean 대견하다/자랑스럽다 already compress much of proud pleasure in another's achievement; preserve as candidate for relation/comparison rather than priority active admission.
Authoritative Swedish evidence centers on nervousness before an upcoming journey, which Korean 여행 전 긴장감/불안 already renders compactly.

The Polish lexeme spans sorrow, pity, grudge, regret and repentance across constructions; breadth may reflect polysemy rather than one bundled experiential state, so it should not be admitted merely because Korean needs several translations.
